behavior.scan: Intel32/Intel64 only. Builds below 10240 scan physical memory; Windows 10 and later scan kernel virtual mappings, including transition pages and skipping repeated page tables.
behavior.constraints: Built-in kernel constraints are scanned with tag-relative headers and versioned object carving. Native74 still applies extra CMHIVE signature validation; remaining type-map and missing-page differences are explicitly tracked below.
behavior.rendering: Tag uses the reference symbol-table type name. Empty names are empty strings. Windows 10+ layer is layer_name; older builds use memory_layer. Offsets retain full canonical values while comparisons accept the reference renderer 48-bit truncation.

known_causes: Native73 Win10 aborted on a file-name page fault; native74 skips it and continues. Matching rows increased from 3801 to 36119 with no extra rows.
Native73 rejected or rounded unaligned headers. Native74 uses exact tag-relative headers and restores Server 2008 full-field agreement.
Server 2003 name descriptor at physical 0x62cfea8 has Length=1. Native74 preserves the odd byte as replacement and now matches every field.
Remaining CMHIVE misses (Win10 45, Win11 51, Win7 4) coincide with native signature validation absent from the reference non-executive carving path; not yet corrected in native74.
Win11 retains 213 extra symbolic-link observations; exact reference type-map and recovery paths require investigation.
Win10 six file and two mutant misses, plus one Win7 file miss, remain unresolved; missing-page/padded object-header behavior requires investigation.
